items.title: Trump Deal for Potash From Belarus Sends Fertilizer Stocks Down
items.summary: In a move to lower fertilizer prices for American farmers, President Trump said the U.S. plans to buy potash from Belarus, undercutting higher-priced Canadian imports.  Stocks of North American fertilizer companies fell Monday.  Potash supplier Nutrien fell 3%.
